integrity: Claims are supported by two exhaustive algorithms using different reductions and explicit automorphism witnesses. The review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: A finite classification of four specified graphs and a fixed edge-cut domination convention; no general cubic-graph formula or complexity theorem is claimed. The 2004 precursor full text was unavailable; publication originality may require independent literature review.
title: Optimal edge-cut domination and cut geometry in four cubic symmetric graphs
